floor_history.headline: Honest gap is a pure v0<->v1 RA swap (t->v1, mask->v0), scheduling byte-identical; mask-before-call KILLED (const remats after call).

frontier.hypothesis: Shorten t's live range (or otherwise raise its allocno priority) so t wins v0 over mask, without touching the (inert) mask placement.
frontier.mechanism: t is one reused variable => single long allocno with priority below mask's. Splitting into 3 short webs that reuse v0 would give t->v0, mask->v1 (target); prior split measured 11 but the RTL cause was never captured.
frontier.next_probe: Split t into t0/t1/t2, dump greg, check whether the 3 short webs reuse v0 (target) or scatter to v1/a0 (cause of +2); if scatter is due to two loads being simultaneously live, reorder so each load is dead before the next load's def.

frontier.hypothesis: A directed permuter over the tail RA structure finds a legitimate pure-C form that steers t->v0.
frontier.mechanism: Random+directed PERM mutation of the 3-load + const-store tail against a clean single-function target exposes RA-steering structures manual analysis misses.
frontier.next_probe: Build target.o from asm/funcs/func_80061658.s + prelude at offset 0; run permuter with fresh-seed discipline; vet any sandbox-0 form against the cheat catalog before proposing.

frontier.hypothesis: The winning pure-C form generalizes to the sibling pin cluster.
frontier.mechanism: Siblings share the identical t=$2/mask=$3 pattern; a genuine RA-structure fix (not a pin) should reproduce across them.
frontier.next_probe: After a form flips 61658 to 0, apply the same structure to func_80061710 and sandbox it as a generality check.
